title: Existence of a Condorcet winner
statement: Let $w$ assign an outcome to each pairwise contest among three candidates. A Condorcet winner exists if there is a candidate who defeats each of the other two candidates in their pairwise contests.
caveat: The definition of “is a Condorcet winner” and the sign encoding of contest outcomes are not included in the supplied statement.
